synthesis: DEV-2313 asked whether the backend that 'saves' Scout automated check-ins runs in the background. Investigation (git+grep verified): (1) check-ins are NOT persisted and NO background job exists today — ScoutCheckInRollupQuery computes them live, on-read, from ClickHouse scans proximity to OPEN hotlist addresses (clarity.hotlist FINAL = current-state), cached 2-15 min; backend is correct + 8 tests. (2) The frontend caller was removed 2026-06-09 (f0152f41d), so the endpoint is orphaned and the UI shows nothing. Owner decision: KEEP the UI hidden, but add a BACKGROUND process that periodically computes + persists check-in rollups so an accurate historical record accrues. The accuracy rationale: the live query joins current-open hotlists, so recomputing a past window later undercounts every since-closed order (scan side is safe via scans_cold; the hotlist-openness side decays). A nightly snapshot captures the point-in-time count before it changes.

notes: ACCURACY RATIONALE (the whole point): ScoutCheckInRollupQuery joins clarity.hotlist FINAL (current-state, not point-in-time). Once a hotlist closes/repossesses, recomputing a past window undercounts it. Pinned by test_check_in_counts_exclude_non_open_hotlists. Scan side is safe (scans_cold retains history; only scans_hot has 90d TTL and old windows already route to cold). So the nightly snapshot preserves the hotlist-openness fact before it decays.

Canonical patterns to mirror: CloseInactiveShiftsCommand (Scout scheduled cmd, gate on config('app.experimental.clarity_scout'), CH read + try/catch degrade, writes platform); AggregateGeoHashScanDaily (idempotent ON CONFLICT upsert + ->dailyAt + ->onOneServer); GenerateOrgCache/GenerateRdnCache (per-entity fan-out).

Scout enablement is a USER property: clarity-scout permission (ClarityScoutMiddleware.php:33) + KitSettings supplying User::kit_id (User.php:137-154) + Pennant CLARITY_SCOUT flag (PennantServiceProvider.php:42). Fan-out must resolve drivers this way, not by iterating kits/orgs blindly.
No CDC implications: PeerDB replicates zod.public.* into ClickHouse; the platform schema is not in that set, so scout_check_in_rollups has no downstream CH mirror.
BLAST RADIUS: new migration under database/migrations/** (sensitive glob) — but purely ADDITIVE create-table (no alter/drop). Dalton approved building the table as part of 'add the nightly snapshot'.

CH test fixture helpers (insertHotlist/insertOpenAssignmentAddress/insertScanHot) are duplicated per test class, not a shared trait — the new test copies them (extracting a trait is optional, out of scope).
